result_text:
`all_files.zip` now looks up and names its five entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests, and I did not run an export with a renamed aspect.

The change is in `reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The code now builds the file name for each scope (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`. That is the same helper the loose text files are written with, so the zip reads exactly the names that were written. The order is unchanged.

With the default configuration the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is no longer lost, because the earlier failure came before that step.
